## For macOS volunteers
No Mac version is currently available. Full source and resources are in this repository and the developer release archive. Please describe your Mac hardware (Apple Silicon / Intel), macOS version, build toolchain and target DAWs. A proposed build needs review and real host tests before it can be listed as supported.

Contributions are voluntary and unpaid. Preserve dependency licenses and contributor attribution. Do not include credentials or materials you do not have permission to publish.
